scope: Integrity and reporting acceptance; no newly invented model quality or latency thresholds.

checks.title: Every planned slot is accounted for
checks.criterion: 144 unique sequence/system/repetition slots, 432 main and 144 replay turn slots, or explicit completed/interrupted/unattempted counts; no silently missing slot.
checks.on_failure: Do not call collection complete if required slots remain unattempted.

checks.title: Original attempts remain unchanged
checks.criterion: 22 original whole sequences and 88 attempts appear exactly once; all linked files match original hashes; exceptional final failure remains a failure.
checks.on_failure: Reject pooled results if attempts are duplicated, omitted, overwritten or tail-spliced.

checks.title: Every sequence matches its actual freeze
checks.criterion: Source, workload, protocol, settings, packages, model digests and embedding hashes validate; v1/v2 differences satisfy exact documented continuation compatibility.
checks.on_failure: Reject affected comparisons on unexplained source/settings drift.

checks.title: Actual HTTP calls obey the controlled systems
checks.criterion: All chat bodies use ctx2048, cap192, temperature0, seed42, thinkfalse and keep_alive -1; small/large arms only call their sole model.
checks.on_failure: Reject model-control attribution on any hidden crossover or setting mismatch.

checks.title: Questions and normal main-system history match protocol
checks.criterion: Case order and prompts match frozen workload; each main sequence begins with empty conversation history and retains its normal bounded history; no forced outcome.
checks.on_failure: Explain missing coverage or protocol deviations before claiming matched control.

checks.title: Prepared memory is matched
checks.criterion: Materialized canonical snapshot, deterministic IDs, setup operations and eligible evidence agree across systems; CPU embedder/settings unchanged.
checks.on_failure: Reject uncontrolled memory differences; distinguish normal retrieval/classifier differences.

checks.title: Every independent sequence starts model/process cold
checks.criterion: No initial resident LLM, new process/embedder, empty cache hint; first backend load included and reported; residual RAM/swap and OS-cache limitation documented.
checks.on_failure: Do not describe resident starts as cold or remove initial loading from totals.

checks.title: All main-system positions represented
checks.criterion: Each sequence follows three frozen main-order rotations; replay remains last and pause/cooldown chronology is disclosed.
checks.on_failure: Limit order-independent attribution if required counterbalance is incomplete.

checks.title: Failures and interruptions survive accounting
checks.criterion: Every started request and span has a terminal record or explicit unfinished status; technical failures stay in latency and quality denominators.
checks.on_failure: Do not infer success from absent end markers or drop fast failures.

checks.title: Monotonic timing partitions exactly
checks.criterion: All completed spans are nonnegative, within request/parent intervals, no unrelated overlapping inference spans; exclusive components plus residual equal complete request duration.
checks.on_failure: Reject broken timing accounting before reporting component savings.

checks.title: Startup-inclusive elapsed latency reconciles
checks.criterion: sequence_end-start equals sequence_total and equals startup + request sum + sequence_gaps; cleanup and scheduler waits are separately scoped.
checks.on_failure: Do not label a sum missing startup/gaps as complete sequence latency.

checks.title: Loading is never added twice
checks.criterion: Backend total/load/prefill/decode are reported separately from enclosing wall spans; cold classifier loading can move to generation in replay.
checks.on_failure: Reject totals that add backend loading to already inclusive request times.

checks.title: Transitions use observed actual states
checks.criterion: Unload request and verified absence are separate; pre/post turn and per-call residency identify real model, digest and allocation; selected vs renderer identities remain distinguishable.
checks.on_failure: Do not treat acknowledgment or cached hint alone as verified eviction.

checks.title: Actual DDEE rule exercise is demonstrated
checks.criterion: For each adaptive DDEE sequence/repetition show actual decisions, residency and easy-streak sources on turns3/4; list any deviation rather than forcing expected large/large/large/small.
checks.on_failure: Do not claim measured two-easy behavior without actual transition evidence.

checks.title: Following-turn costs have observed support
checks.criterion: Report first-easy-large and second-easy-small costs; associate available next turns with previous transition; mark last-turn switches as having no later observation.
checks.on_failure: Do not extrapolate an unobserved next turn or hide return-to-small cost.

checks.title: Replay exactly preserves adaptive generation requests
checks.criterion: Every replay turn maps to its adaptive source; highlevel messages/model/schema, full HTTP bodies and history match; zero new selector calls; reused classifier metadata never counted as inference.
checks.on_failure: Reject selection-cost attribution for any nonmatching or unavailable replay; retain failure separately.

checks.title: Guards and serial inference remained active
checks.criterion: No unexplained competing experiment, guard violation, telemetry loss, model overlap, boot/power/trip change or swap-topology change; every sequence cleanup verified.
checks.on_failure: Report actual violations/uncertainty; do not claim all runs passed without final evidence.

checks.title: Attribution limits are quantified
checks.criterion: Report allocation size/size_vram, backend token counts, decode length/rate and timing by sequence/repetition; distinguish allocation ratio from exact compute placement.
checks.on_failure: Qualify routing causality where placement, length or cache differences contribute.

checks.title: Comparisons respect pairing and dependence
checks.criterion: Paired differences against both fixed systems and replay use matched sequence/repetition; show all patterns/repetitions; average repeats within sequence before descriptive resampling; no independent-turn sample claim.
checks.on_failure: Do not pool unmatched observations or advertise 576 independent samples.

checks.title: Every delivered answer has an auditable judgment
checks.criterion: Frozen rubric and actual evidence used; failures receive technical_failure; blinded mapping covers every attempt; reviewer type, rationale, agreement and adjudication retained.
checks.on_failure: No quality-latency improvement claim until correctness coverage is complete.

checks.title: Useful answers and delivery are distinct
checks.criterion: Full-rubric success is distinct from JSON validity/delivery; fast failures and known-answer abstentions are not gains; social subset limitations stated.
checks.on_failure: Do not equate validated delivery or lower wall time with useful-answer improvement.

checks.title: Report is reproducible and conclusions match evidence
checks.criterion: Raw traces, input/source hashes, CSV/JSON tables, figures, commands and original failures preserved; state cost recovery separately against each fixed system, which patterns benefited and remaining uncertainty.
checks.on_failure: Do not conclude superiority without comparator-specific measured support.

notes: Evidence filenames under report/ are intended roles; use actual analyzer output names when resolving checks.
A pending check is not a passed check.
This file does not require useful-answer superiority; null or unfavorable findings are valid.
Independent human review remains pending unless actually obtained.
